title: Rebuild T3 center-lifecycle isolation for comments and reactions
verify: Retained prior-center comments and field reactions are neither projected nor mutable after supported class identity reuse, while distinct current-center objects remain usable.
Account/field comment ownership and actor/target reaction uniqueness remain center-scoped without losing attribution or retained prior-center rows.

evidence: Fresh verifier-owned center-reuse probe passed 2/2; comments/reactions checks passed 3/3 with retained-row preservation, denial of prior-center reads/mutations, current-center usability, and safe cleanup.
npm run check and npm run build passed; executor full-suite result remains supporting-only.
Independent hostile review found no material cross-center privacy, ownership, persistence, boundary, or scope drift in the TASK-016 outcome.

evidence_required: FT-004-AC-001 RED: supported center identity reuse projects or permits mutation of a retained prior-center field comment, or current-center ownership/attribution fails; GREEN: prior-center comments are denied or absent from the replacement-center projection, current-center comments remain one-per-account-per-field with author/last-change attribution, and retained rows are unchanged; artifact: .tasks/TASK-016-T3-FT-004-W6/ and .protocols/TASK-016-T3-FT-004-W6/verification.md.

FT-004-AC-002 RED: supported center identity reuse projects, mutates, or collides with a retained prior-center field reaction, or reactor visibility is incorrect; GREEN: five standard reactions remain usable only in the current center, prior-center reactions and reactors are not exposed or mutable, and center-scoped uniqueness holds; artifact: .tasks/TASK-016-T3-FT-004-W6/ and .protocols/TASK-016-T3-FT-004-W6/verification.md.

FT-004-AC-005 RED: shared/personal comment or reaction data crosses the current server-resolved center/class/student scope; GREEN: protected reads and mutations use actor plus server-resolved scope, deny cross-center access without existence leakage, and preserve old rows; artifact: .tasks/TASK-016-T3-FT-004-W6/ and .protocols/TASK-016-T3-FT-004-W6/verification.md.
purpose: Re-establish the protected Collaboration boundary for account-owned comments and reactions after supported center identity reuse exposed retained prior-center data.
success_outcome: Comments and field reactions remain attributable, center-scoped, and usable in the replacement center; retained prior-center objects cannot be read, targeted, mutated, or collided with through the replacement lifecycle.
anti_goals: Do not edit, re-tier, close, or reuse TASK-012-T2-FT-004-W6 as this task.
Do not inherit TASK-011 evidence as current T3 proof or change TASK-011 lifecycle.
Do not delete retained Collaboration rows or introduce a second Collaboration writer.
Do not change the accepted modular-monolith graph, shared database decision, or public boundary.
constraints: Collaboration exclusively writes comments and reactions; actor and class/student scope are resolved through the accepted public boundaries.
Every protected read, target check, and mutation combines the authenticated actor with server-resolved center/class/student scope.
The one shared database retains prior Collaboration rows; center-scoped uniqueness is enforced without deleting historical data.
Verification uses isolated disposable state, safe rerun, and cleanup with no network, credentials, or production data.
invariants: Cross-center reads and mutations are denied without revealing unrelated object existence.
An account has at most one editable comment per field within the current center scope, with author and last-change attribution.
A standard reaction is unique to its actor and target within the current center scope, and permitted viewers see its reactors.
Prior-center comments and reactions remain retained and behaviorally unchanged after a replacement-center lifecycle.
verification_targets: FT-004-AC-001: public-boundary ownership/attribution and center identity-reuse matrix for comment read, create, edit, and one-per-account-per-field behavior.
FT-004-AC-002: five-reaction public-boundary matrix for field/comment/message target compatibility, reactor projection, center isolation, and actor/target uniqueness.
FT-004-AC-005: shared/personal and cross-center negative authorization matrix with read, target, mutation, retained-row, and no-existence-leak assertions.
.memory-bank/contracts/access-control.md#authority-and-scope: protected reads and commands use actor plus server-resolved center/class/student scope.
.memory-bank/contracts/boundary-map.md#day-discussion-query-boundary: Collaboration remains the sole writer and Lesson Context consumes only the named scoped public boundary.
.memory-bank/domains/core-domain.md#persistence-and-transaction-rules: isolated persistence comparison proves retained rows and center-scoped uniqueness without partial writes.
.memory-bank/states/lifecycle-map.md#collaboration: comment ownership/attribution and scope-sensitive Collaboration transitions remain valid.
.memory-bank/testing/strategy.md#evidence-and-ownership: task-scoped RED/GREEN, state-before/state-after, safe rerun, and cleanup evidence.

stop_conditions: Stop and route to /spec-design if satisfying the accepted boundary requires changing the modular-monolith graph, public contract, or shared database decision.
Stop if comment/reaction ownership must move outside Collaboration or if retained prior-center data would be deleted.
